cc:Work.dc:title: communication-study-decision-geometry
cc:Work.dc:description: Ideal synchronized equal-prior BPSK conditional Gaussian decision densities with Es=1 and noise sigma=0.5 show threshold zero. Separate QPSK constellation has Es=1 and Gray labels 00,10,11,01. A noise displacement takes 00 to the 10 quadrant, illustrating one neighboring bit error. The charts do not compare BER at fixed Eb and do not claim all symbol errors are one bit.
